text: 1348 changes favicon_url from a single URL format to choices: relativeUrl for maximum manifest version 2 and strictRelativeUrl for the remaining accepted format. Accepted schema retains the choice layout, optional flag and localization preprocessing. For this property, retain the version boundary in the schema rather than infer one URL policy from its name. Schema and caller-independent source were read; no live manifest validation or extension loading ran. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Manifest search favicon formats are versioned schema choices
